title: Grade 3 Math — Fri, Jun 20
description: Decimals — Day 5 of 5: Mixed — fractions to decimals, word problems
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Which fraction equals 0.2?
questions.explanation: 0.2 = 2/10 = 1/5. Two tenths is the same as one fifth.

questions.question: Meera bought 1.5 m of red cloth and 0.75 m of blue cloth. How much cloth in all?
A water tank holds 3.5 L. Another holds 2.75 L. Together they hold ___ L.
Which decimal is NOT equivalent to 1/2?
questions.explanation: 0.05 = 5/100 = 1/20. It is NOT the same as 1/2 (which is 0.5). All others (0.5, 0.50, 0.500) equal 1/2.

questions.question: Write 3.4 as a mixed number (whole + fraction):
What decimal is halfway between 0.4 and 0.6?
Jay walked 0.5 km, then 0.25 km, then 0.25 km. Total distance = ___.
questions.explanation: 0.5 + 0.25 + 0.25 = 1.0 km. He walked exactly 1 km in total.
2.5 = 2 + 0.5 (2 ones + 5 tenths). 0.5 is the fractional part.

questions.question: A shopkeeper weighs 1.25 kg of flour and 0.75 kg of sugar. Which is heavier, and by how much?
questions.explanation: 1.25 − 0.75 = 0.5 kg. Flour (1.25 kg) is heavier than sugar (0.75 kg) by 0.5 kg.

questions.question: WEEK SUMMARY: Which statement about decimals is correct?
options: Tenths come BEFORE hundredths (closer to the decimal point)
questions.explanation: Tenths (1 decimal place) come before hundredths (2 decimal places). 0.1 = 1 tenth; 0.01 = 1 hundredth. 0.50 = 0.5 (equal). 1/2 = 0.5.
